title: Local identifier
description: A locally-unique identifier for this organisation.

title: Name
description: A name for this organisation. The name should be unique amongst the organisations belonging to a network.

title: Identifier
description: The identifier assigned to the organisation in the register identified in `.scheme`.

title: Scheme
description: The register from which the identifier in `.id` is drawn, from the open [organisationIdentifierScheme codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#organisationidentifierscheme).

title: Legal name
description: The legally registered name of the organisation

title: URI
description: A canonical URI for this identifier, such as those provided by Open Corporates. Do not use this field to provide the website of the organisation: instead, use `Organisation.website`.

title: Country
description: The country in which this organisation is legally registered, from the closed [country codelist](https://standard.ofds.info/en/{{version}}/reference/codelists#country).

title: Role details
description: Further details about this organisation's roles in the network

title: Website
description: The URL of the website for this organisation.

title: Logo
description: The URL of the logo for this organisation.
